actual_scope: Characteristic 5 only, six sources, unchanged unsigned dirty connector. For a floor word that realizes all fifteen weight-2 masks and the weight-6 mask, legal S(16) is impossible. Illegal S(16) is not decided. No kappa change.
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card asks for one new connector operation. This package keeps the alphabet fixed and answers open question 1 of open PR 7058: the status of S(16) on a floor word realizing every weight-2 mask and the weight-6 mask together. A new operation is not the missing step. The centre-freeze of PR 7038, the separate counterexamples of PR 7058, the adjacent-centre remainder, and the c=6 and c=7 remainders are other questions. The merged DRAT certificate in PR 6216 is not an input.
bottleneck_link: Side result on the recursive-interface schedule. It does not change a supplier, a consumer, or kappa. PR 7038 leaves open whether the sixteen masks of weights 2 and 6 force a legal sum-33 centre. This census shows they do not: legal S(16) is incompatible with that conjunction. It does not prove the conjunction empty and does not prove the characteristic-5 depth-two exclusion.
stop_rule: Stop when every canonical legal centre of both shapes has been accepted or rejected for the sixteen masks, including the independent Python replay of the two-zero shape. Do not treat a search outside that finite domain as emptiness.
evidence: Exhaustive finite census. Legal S(16) has 300 pairs and only the shapes (5,5,3,3,0,0) with the centre letter on a zero and (5,3,3,3,2,0) with the centre letter on the 2. First-occurrence canonical prefixes: 10090080 and 67267200, matching an independent dynamic program. Future-box survivors: 8793 and 13496310. No survivor extends to all fifteen weight-2 masks and the weight-6 mask. The two-zero half matches an independent Python enumerator on examined roots, survivors, suffix nodes, and solutions. The weight-2 family alone still admits both centre polarities, and one all-ones word still has a legal centre with only five weight-2 masks. Illegal S(16) under the conjunction is not decided.
